title: sample-unicode
overview: A synthetic capability whose long requirement holds a character outside the Basic Multilingual Plane.

requirements.name: Long rule with a symbol
requirements.text: The sample gate SHALL count the mathematical symbol 𝔸 the way JavaScript counts it, as two UTF-16 code units, and this requirement is long on purpose so that the validator reports it. It SHALL carry enough words to pass the limit: a first clause about inputs, a second clause about outputs, a third clause about the error conditions that follow from both, and a fourth that repeats the first three in a shorter form. The text SHALL then add an example, then another example, then a closing sentence that adds nothing new to the rule at all.

scenarios.name: Symbol counted twice
scenarios.rawText:
- **WHEN** the gate measures this requirement
- **THEN** the symbol adds two to its length
